7018-a-collection-of-scotch-proverbs.creator: Anonymous
7018-a-collection-of-scotch-proverbs.description: A book by Anonymous. rvive in a form disguised beyond all chance of recognition. Although editions of it published in 1610, 1614, and "divers other Years" with "Mr. Fergusson's Additions" have been reported, no copies of them have been found. Fergusson" is no doubt David Fergusson (ca. 1525-1598), whose _Scottish Proverbs_ was published at Edinburgh in 1641.

74873-poems-of-reflection.title: Reflection
74873-poems-of-reflection.creator: Ella Wheeler Wilcox
74873-poems-of-reflection.description: A book by Ella Wheeler Wilcox. Herein can dwell no pretense and no seeming;   No stilted pride thrives in this atmosphere, Which stimulates a tendency to dreaming. The shores of the ideal world, from here,   Seem sometimes to be tangible and near.

arxiv-2209-15146.title: Ensemble Machine Learning Model Trained on a New Synthesized Dataset Generalizes Well for Stress Prediction Using Wearable Devices Journal: Journal of Biomedical Informatics
arxiv-2209-15146.creator: Gideon Vos, Kelly Trinh, Zoltan Sarnyai, Mostafa Rahimi Azghadi
arxiv-2209-15146.description: Abstract Introduction Advances in wearable sensor technology have enabled the collection of biomarkers that may correlate with levels of elevated stress. While significant research has been done in this domain, specifically in using machine learning to detect elevated levels of stress, the challenge of producing a machine learning model capable of generalizing well for use on new, unseen data remain.

arxiv-2404-06673.title: Non-extensive Effects on the QCD Equation of State and Fluctuations of Conserved Charges within Polyakov Quark Meson Model
arxiv-2404-06673.creator: Abdel Magied DIAB
arxiv-2404-06673.description: Abstract The influence of non-extensive Tsallis statistics on the hadron phase structure has been investigated using the Polyakov-quark-meson (PQM) model. The analysis examines the non-extensive effects on the temperature dependence of PQM order parameters, thermodynamic quantities related to the QCD equation of state, and fluctuations of conserved charges at varying chemical potentials.

arxiv-2410-21956.title: Testing tree level TeV scale seesaw scenarios in μ \mu TRISTAN
arxiv-2410-21956.creator: Arindam Das, Jinmian Li, Sanjoy Mandal, Takaaki Nomura, Rao Zhang
arxiv-2410-21956.description: Abstract We investigate TeV scale seesaw scenarios at μ + ​ e − \mu^{+}e^{-} and μ + ​ μ + \mu^{+}\mu^{+} colliders in the μ \mu TRISTAN experiment. In minimal type-I seesaw scenario we consider two generations of Standard Model (SM) singlet heavy Majorana type Right Handed Neutrinos (RHNs) which couples with SM gauge bosons through light-heavy neutrino mixing.

arxiv-2412-02625.title: Identifying Hierarchically Triple Star Systems with Gaia DR3 and LAMOST
arxiv-2412-02625.creator: Tongyu He, Jiao Li, Jiangdan Li, Jianping Xiong, Xiaobin Zhang, Mikhail Kovalev, Qiyuan Cheng, Sufen Guo, Mingkuan Yang, Xuefei Chen, Zhanwen Han
arxiv-2412-02625.description: Abstract Triple star systems are critical for understanding stellar dynamics and compact objects in astrophysics, yet confirmed hierarchical triples identified via spectroscopy remain limited. In this study, we identified 23 triple systems by cross-matching the Gaia DR3 non-single star catalog with LAMOST DR10 spectroscopic data, 18 of them are new discoveries.

arxiv-2505-11581.title: Questioning Representational Optimism in Deep Learning: The Fractured Entangled Representation Hypothesis
arxiv-2505-11581.creator: Akarsh Kumar, Jeff Clune, Joel Lehman, Kenneth O. Stanley
arxiv-2505-11581.description: Abstract Much of the excitement in modern AI is driven by the observation that scaling up existing systems leads to better performance. But does better performance necessarily imply better internal representations? While the representational optimist assumes it must, this position paper challenges that view.

arxiv-2601-04535.title: Maximal Entanglement and Frozen Information: A Unified Framework for Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
arxiv-2601-04535.creator: Kaiyuan Cao, Mingzhi Li, Xiang-Ping Jiang, Shu Chen, Jian Wang
arxiv-2601-04535.description: Abstract Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) are temporal singularities marked by zeros of the Loschmidt echo, yet their underlying quantum-information structure remains elusive. Here, we introduce a momentum-resolved entanglement entropy as a direct probe of DQPTs in translation-invariant free systems.

plos-pone-0000789.creator: Se-Jin Lee
plos-pone-0000789.description: PLOS ONE research article. Myostatin is a transforming growth factor-ß family member that normally acts to limit skeletal muscle growth. Mice genetically engineered to lack myostatin activity have about twice the amount of muscle mass throughout the body, and similar effects are seen in cattle, sheep, dogs

pmc-10569703.title: Electric field–assisted anion-π catalysis on carbon nanotubes in electrochemical microfluidic devices
pmc-10569703.creator: M. Ángeles Gutiérrez López, Rojan Ali, Mei-Ling Tan, Naomi Sakai, Thomas Wirth, Stefan Matile
pmc-10569703.description: The vision to control the charges migrating during reactions with external electric fields is attractive because of the promise of general catalysis, emergent properties, and programmable devices. Here, we explore this idea with anion-π catalysis, that is the stabilization of anionic transition states on aromatic surfaces. Catalyst activation by polarization of the aromatic system is most effective.

pmc-10622725.title: Spontaneous Multiple Cervical Artery Dissections and Recurrent Deep Vein Thrombosis in a Young Adult
pmc-10622725.creator: Maurizio Giorelli, Ruggiero Leone, Rosario Francesco Balzano
pmc-10622725.description: pulation remains controversial, since some patients report only facial pain and the pathology may be underestimated.3 Multiple simultaneous, spontaneous CADs are even rarer, possibly accounting for 15% of all CADs.2 A 46-year-old male presented to our emergency room with headache, confusion, and mood fluctuations. A clinical examination revealed left Horner’s syndrome with no other neurological signs.

pmc-11383726.title: Association of MCP-4, NRTN, and PD-L1 with the risk of hepatic fibrosis: A Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11383726.creator: Liqun Li, Jing Yan, Qian Liu, Laian Ge, Yifeng Pan, Bingjie Han, Chunmei Wang, Xiaomei Tang, Lijian Liu, Sheng Xie
pmc-11383726.description: Previous studies have confirmed the affiliation between specific inflammatory cytokines and Hepatic fibrosis (HF); however, contradictions remain in the causality. The study implemented a bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis with published statistics derived from Genome-wide Association Studies (GWAS) to investigate casualties between inflammatory cytokines and HF.

pmc-11625039.title: Intravascular ultrasound-guided reentry wiring with tip-detection technique for chronic total occlusion of lower extremity artery disease
pmc-11625039.creator: Naoki Hayakawa, Hiromi Miwa, Yasuyuki Tsuchida, Shinya Ichihara, Shunsuke Maruta, Shunichi Kushida
pmc-11625039.description: BackgroundEndovascular therapy is an effective method for revascularization in lower extremity artery disease, but treating chronic total occlusion (CTO) remains challenging. This is particularly true for patients with severe calcification, poor run-off in below-the-knee arteries, or limited access sites, where even guidewire (GW) passage can be difficult and bidirectional approaches are often not feasible.

pmc-11665453.title: Kinematics and kinetics of dogs walking over increasing heights of cavaletti exercise
pmc-11665453.creator: Katie Clarke, Jade Terry, Scott Blake, Roberta Ferro de Godoy
pmc-11665453.description: The purpose of this study was to identify the effects of four heights of cavaletti exercise on canine kinematics and kinetics. Eight dogs had kinematics and kinetics data collected whilst completing cavaletti pole exercises at four different heights (floor, mid-metatarsal, hock, and stifle). Dogs had anatomical markers placed on bony landmarks of the fore and hindlimb joints.

pmc-11709070.title: Does early heart rate detection and continuous monitoring have an impact on neonatal resuscitation in newborns with intact cord? – An observational study
pmc-11709070.creator: Sushil Choudhary, Arun Singh, Anurag Pandey, Neeraj Gupta, Anil Kumar, Swasthi Kabisatpathy
pmc-11709070.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Context:Heart rate (HR) is the most vital parameter to assess hemodynamic transition at birth. ECG is considered a gold standard for HR assessment. New devices with dry electrodes are easy to apply on a wet newborn.

pmc-12502171.title: Efficacy of Vector Guard®, a mosaic alpha-cypermethrin and piperonyl butoxide-treated net, for the control of pyrethroid-resistant malaria vectors: a non-inferiority experimental hut evaluation in Benin
pmc-12502171.creator: Judicael Nounagnon, Martial Gbegbo, Abel Agbevo, Estelle Vigninou, Boris N’dombidjé, Corine Ngufor
pmc-12502171.description: BackgroundInsecticide-treated nets (ITNs) incorporating pyrethroids with piperonyl butoxide (PBO) have demonstrated enhanced effectiveness against malaria transmitted by pyrethroid-resistant vectors compared with standard pyrethroid-only ITNs. To sustain progress in malaria prevention, a broader portfolio of effective pyrethroid-PBO nets is required to promote market diversity and strengthen supply resilience.

pmc-12844970.title: When Salmonella Strikes the Brain: A Systematic Review of Non-Typhoidal Salmonella Infections with Central Nervous System Involvement in Immunosuppressed Patients
pmc-12844970.creator: Giulia Turicchi, Marco Bongiovanni
pmc-12844970.description: Central nervous system (CNS) infections caused by Salmonella species (spp.) are exceptionally rare in adults but are associated with significant morbidity and mortality, particularly in immunocompromised individuals. Clinical presentation is often nonspecific, including fever, headache, or altered mental status, while imaging may demonstrate meningeal enhancement, abscesses, or cytotoxic lesions. We present a systematic review of non-typhoidal Salmonella spp.

And his career was a study in audacity and late blooming. He was born on 7 November 1930, in Bellevue, Pennsylvania. His father worked for a steel company. His mother was a schoolteacher.

pmc-13233009.title: Lessons Learned From Implementing a Culturally Tailored Virtual Support Program for Asian American Breast Cancer Survivors With Pain and Depression
pmc-13233009.creator: Seulgi Ryu, Dongmi Kim, Wonshik Chee, Eun-Ok Im, Amaryllis Mavragani
pmc-13233009.description: Breast cancer is the most diagnosed cancer among women in the United States, with a greater increase in incidence among Asian American women than among others. Despite having resided in the United States for decades, Asian American breast cancer survivors face unique cultural challenges, including stigma and reluctance to disclose their illness.

pmc-13407769.title: Reprogramming the immunosuppressive microenvironment in MSS/pMMR colorectal cancer via synergistic pyroptosis induction and PD-L1 suppression
pmc-13407769.creator: Jingyi Mo, Weirui Huang, Rongrong Li, Yiqiong Xie, Lei Chang
pmc-13407769.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Colorectal cancer (CRC) with microsatellite-stable (MSS)/pMMR status resists immune checkpoint blockade due to its immunologically “cold” tumor microenvironment. We developed Lipo-LPS-Rg3, a dual-functional nanoliposome co-delivering lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and ginsenoside Rg3, to simultaneously ignite pyroptosis and attenuate PD-L1-associated immune suppression. LPS triggered GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis, releasing DAMPs and recruiting CD8+ T cells, while Rg3 reduced PD-L1 expression in vitro, at least partly by inhibiting NFATc1 nuclear translocation.

pmc-13445327.title: Agent‐Based Simulations of Lung Tumor Evolution Suggest That Ongoing Cell Competition Drives Realistic Clonal Expansions
pmc-13445327.creator: Helena Coggan, James R M Black, Carlos Martínez‐Ruiz, Kristiana Grigoriadis, Jasmin Fisher, Nicholas McGranahan
pmc-13445327.description: Computational simulations of tumor evolution are increasingly used to infer the rules underlying cancer growth. To make reliable inferences, such models must be able to reflect the properties of real tumors. Recent work has shown that lung tumors undergo frequent and late subclonal expansions, which are associated with poor prognosis.

pmc-13726372.title: Impact of Genetic Polymorphisms on Bortezomib-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy in Multiple Myeloma: A Systematic Review and Bioinformatics Analysis
pmc-13726372.creator: Nadeen S Sultan, Ahmed S Alhallaq, Mohammed S Alhallaq, Heba Mohammed Arafat, Sadeen Eid, Ashraf Jaber Shaqaliah
pmc-13726372.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Bortezomib, a 26S proteasome inhibitor, has become a cornerstone in the treatment of multiple myeloma. However, its use is limited by a common and potentially serious adverse effect, bortezomib-induced peripheral neuropathy (BIPN), which manifests in 30-60% of multiple myeloma patients primarily as a sensory, distal, axonal neuropathy, often with pain, numbness, tingling, and in some cases, motor involvement, which can lead to dose reductions, therapy discontinuation, or long-term morbidity.

uslaw-usc-t7-s192.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 9 (Packers And Stockyards); Subchapter II (Packers Generally); Part A (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It shall be unlawful for any packer or swine contractor with respect to livestock, meats, meat food products, or livestock products in unmanufactured form, or for any live poultry dealer with respect to live poultry, to: (a) Engage.
